notice: Pending-events contract: one file per event the human must attend, only in gtt-domain/pending/. Data only. The engine (.gtt/scripts/gtt_pending.py), the hook (.claude/hooks/pending-watch.py) and the CLI (gtt pending, gtt answer) read it; none carries these texts, limits or numbers of its own.
threshold: Settle simple, reversible questions yourself: take the simplest option and continue. Ask the human only decisions that are theirs (account, key, money, legal, product, governed file) and that governed context cannot settle. Tell them a decision only when it changes scope, time, cost, security or the design. One file per event, only through gtt-pending.sh; plain words, one idea per line. With no answer, use the recommended option. Apply each answer where it belongs, then mark it with `done`. If something is pending, end your report with `@gtt · Needs you`. Never write the human's answer.

limits.note: The limits apply to what the engine writes (up to and including the answer label); the answer area is the human's and is only checked for key shapes and its line length.

en.answer_hint: (ok, or tell me what to change)

en.tail: Answer here, in the file or with gtt answer
en.tail_fyi: Say «ok» or tell me what to change

es.tail: Responde aquí, en el archivo o con gtt answer

rules.statement: an event is at most max_lines lines of at most max_chars characters (what the engine wrote)
a question is one line that ends in «?»; it has 2 or 3 options and exactly one is recommended
a question carries a type of the list; a decision carries an `Affects` of the list
a decision has three lines (what, why, where it landed) and every `Where it landed` exists
an answer never looks like a key; a key goes in .env.local
the name, the number and the heading of an event agree, and no number repeats
an answered event that nobody marked is waiting to be applied
